how: pnpm build, then pnpm serve on :5590. Production build, not the dev server — the unquoted-attribute behaviour these checks are written against is a minifier artifact and does not appear under `pnpm start`.

routes._self_test_note: Recorded as 7/7 while this branch was in progress; the committed script gave 13/13 by the time it was pushed. Re-derived after --json became a stdout flag, which retired the two safe_output_path cases: 11/11.
routes.note: Baseline recorded 21 routes. 22 en routes exist now: AAASM-5589 added /denied-action-proof. The remaining 22 are zh-Hant.

metadata.self_test: 18/18, including an unquoted-attribute fixture and a negative control proving a quote-only regex finds nothing in it
metadata.note: term_not_in_body and ladder_upgrade are the SEO acceptance criterion. Both zero, from a checker whose fixtures trip on a planted violation.

sitemap_locales.why_it_mattered: The served robots.txt is Cloudflare-managed and carries no Sitemap: line, so /zh-Hant/sitemap.xml had nothing pointing at it while the HTML hreflang alternates named both locales.

keyboard.skip_link_end_to_end: Tab -> Enter -> Tab lands on the first link inside <main>, bypassing the navbar. Verified with real key events, not element.focus().

contrast.method: WCAG 2.1 ratio computed per text-bearing element against its effective composited background
contrast.control: a grey-on-grey node planted in the page before each scan; findings count moved 8->9 (light) and 0->1 (dark), and the planted node was named in the output

dark_mode.note: dark is the configured default mode and is clean

reduced_motion.note: no running animation to suppress on the page measured
